notes.title: Full release of Desecrators out now!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 is finally here! It was a long and interesting ride. A huge thanks to all our Early Access players!

We are very excited to enter this new phase!

[b]Note: This version is incompatible with saves from previous versions![/b]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Galatic Treasury:
- New final level
- A new anomaly signature has been detected...
[*]Gauntlet mode option added:
- No resurrectors
- No saves
- More relics
[*]New game menu reworked:
- Added additional details for difficulty options
[*]Mission end and run end screens reworked:
- Displays individual stats for all players
- Added additional feedback
- Looks cooler
[*]Rebalanced rivals:
- Increased health
- Slightly lowered overall damage
- Reduced secondary reload rate
- Dodging pattern is now less jittery and more predictable
- Removed bonus move speed and turn rate on Hazard 4/5
- Rival spawning now has a short delay (similar to other enemies)
[*]Enemies health scaling now also reduces knockback they receive from damage
[*]Enemies reaction time is more forgiving for players entering rooms
[*]Reduced health of all Chamo enemies
[*]Stingers are now more aggresive when player has low health or when attacking from behind
[*]Increased Mega Mine Layer pickup drop count
[*]Turrets are now less likely to spawn near room entrances
[*]Multi-tile room entrances can now be fitted with doors and projectile traps
[*]Phantom Walls now sometimes have a random activation delay
[*]Enemies are now doubly affected by meltdown shake forces
[*]Duplicate weapon pickups can now increase ammo above normal limit
[*]Weapon upgrades can now be previewed when player does not have enough credits
[/list]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapon slots reworked:
- Can no longer be purchased with credits
- Now instead uses 'weapon slot' points
- Weapon slot points can be found as pickups in levels
- Increased max weapon slots 3 -> 4
[*]Bubblebomb is now proximity fused (projectile will detonate when close to enemies)
[*]Pillager now disarms and destroys mines on impact (kills mines without detonating them)
[*]Enemies now always drop max number of pickups when pillagede
[*]Bladder Mine fragments are now hydrodynamic (less affeced by underwater friction)
[*]Reduced Banshee fire rate and move speed
[*]Reduced Beehive fragment turn rate 200 -> 170
[*]Increased Impulse ammo cost 5/7/9 -> 5/8/11
[*]Increased Autopulser ammo cost 5/5.5/6 -> 5.5/6/6.5
[*]Increased Ack-Am damage 66/74/82 -> 70/80/90
[*]Increased Foamphase damage 60/66/72 -> 60/70/80
[*]Reduced Foamphase projectile speed 240 -> 230
[*]Reduced Ack-Am projectile speed 300 -> 250
[/list]

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked view animations:
- Update all weapon recoil animations
- Adjusted weapon movement sway animation
- Improved weapon knockback animation
- Remastered all screenshake effects
[*]Added new move animations for Orca
[*]Improved player and rival engine FX
[*]Updated Thermo model
[*]Removed Halloween main menu decorations
[*]Improved graphics for HUD lock indicators
[*]Improved enemy spawning FX
[*]Adjusted Kraken, Autopulser and Multipine impact FX for better visibility
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked underwater sound mixing:
- Increased audible range of all sounds 
- Improved mixing for occluded sounds
- Underwater-specific are now less muffled
[*]Improved Bubblebomb firing sound
[*]Improved Multipine firing sound
[*]Improved Pyro and Plasma firing sounds
[*]Improved Mega Mine detonation sound
[*]Improved breakable destruction sounds
[*]Added audio feedback for Exopod loss
[*]Added activation sound for enemy generators
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added missing Exopod Swarm database description
[*]Fixed some enemy database descriptions still referencing Mine Ammo pickups
[*]Fixed Pillager autoselect priority being higher than intended
[*]Fixed weapon wheel being able to stay open during dropship sequences
[*]Fixed rare game freeze that could occur when a respawning player triggered a phantom wall
[*]Fixed player not being able to use exopod pickups to repair existing pods when ship was at max number of exopods
[*]Fixed weapon ammo bars sometimes getting stuck
[*]Fixed Smartbomb shockwave sometimes not dealing damage
[/list]

notes.title: Desecrators 0.4.7 - Gameplay update
notes.notes:
Desecrators 0.4.7 features a host of gameplay focused changes. Three new enemies have been detected: The Gun Husk, the Duel Tank and the Marauder.

Changelist:
[list]
[*]Players start with Headlight and Turbo upgrades
[*]Pickups are now shared between players
[*]Pickup density is no longer affected by player count
[*]Duplicate primaries can now be picked up for an ammo bonus
[*]Mine trigger radius increased
[*]Beehive fragments now create shockwaves on impact
[*]If an enemy triggers a mine, the radius damage is now centered at the point where the enemy triggered the mine and not the position of the mine itself
[*]Increased Prox Mine max ammo from 9 to 12
[*]Gravity well pull effect is now reduced for friendly targets
[*]Some enemies can now drop multiple Secondary pickups
[*]AI reaction time is slower and more directly influenced by vision and hearing
[*]AI will now react to doors being opened
[*]AI is now less accurate when firing beam weapons at long range
[*]Reduced enemy projectile speed for Hazard level 1 and 2
[*]Reduced enemy health and speed for Hazard level 4 and 5
[*]Extended level 6 tileset
[*]Added Gun Husk enemy
[*]Added Duel Tank enemy
[*]Added Marauder enemy
[*]Reworked Borehead engine sound
[*]Added unique ambience sounds for level 6
[*]Added moisture environment FX to certain rooms
[*]Teleports are now coloured by pairs
[*]Teleports now use an unique model on the map
[*]Teleport destinations are now visible on the map
[*]Levels can now contain destructable grates
[*]Destructable secret surfaces are marked with a transparent pattern instead of a different brightness 
[*]Boxes of loot may now spawn
[*]Added feedback for finding all secrets in a level
[*]Improved Beehive FX
[*]Various lighting optimizations
[*]Improved performance when using lowest lighting quality setting
[*]Fixed buttons spawning on floors if there are no valid wall spawns nearby
[*]Fixed buttons sometimes spawning on uneven surfaces
[*]Fixed disabled teleports being visible on the map
[*]Fixed menu sliders sometimes having incorrect decimal values 
[*]Fixed players dropping primaries not working correctly in multiplayer
[*]Fixed HUD fuel bar getting stuck on screen during player death spin
[*]Fixed a rare issue that could cause level surface extrusions to overlap
[*]Fixed players being able to leave the dropship during the launch and docking sequence
[*]Fixed teleports sometimes not being active on clients
[*]Fixed inconsistent behaviour for when pickup maxed out messages were displayed
[*]Fixed Map not closing when the player is killed
[*]Fixed a rare bug where ground enemies would attempt to join air formations
[/list]

notes.title: Desecrators 0.3.0 - Scores and secrets update
notes.notes:
Desecrators now features a score system. Kill enemies, find artifacts and find secret rooms to gain score. With enough score extra lives can be gained. Secret rooms may now appear throughout the levels.
Note: The score is shared among players.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Score system added
[*]Light decals added
[*]Significant rework of the level generation
[*]Levels can now contain secret rooms
[*]New primary weapon added: Impulse
[*]Levels can no longer contain duplicate primary weapons
[*]Added support for multiple controllers
[*]Made portals more distinct on the level map
[*]Small visual change to gold pickups
[*]Added artifact pickups. Collecting them provides a score bonus.
[*]Mine camera spin reduced
[*]Improved various sounds
[*]Bubble bomb gravity well now more reliably pulls enemies toward its center
[*]Fixed rare case where enemy projectiles could start inside level geometry
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause clients to time out after a level switch
[*]Fixed having map open during level switch causing a black screen
[*]Fixed various multiplayer issues
[*]Fixed an AI performance issue that could cause uneven framerate.
[/list]

notes.title: Desecrators 0.2.0 - Campaign update
notes.notes:
Desecrators now feature a basic campaign of 4 levels.  Enemy spawns has been changed so you start with only encountering the easier enemy types. Once you beat the 4 levels you will loop back to the first level with all your pickups and weapons. You will need them because the difficulty increases with each loop. Tell us how many loops you can make!

Changelog:
[list]
[*]4 levels with distinct generation styles
[*]Difficulty adjustments
[*]Enemy waves are much less likely to spawn near players
[*]Various lighting improvements
[*]Sound propagation is now affected by the level layout and obstructions such as closed doors 
[*]Reduced level loading times
[*]Enemies will no longer move before level intro sequence is completed
[*]Added maxed out HUD messages for all pickups
[*]Added various UI and HUD sounds.
[*]Improved turret AI handling for targets out of sight
[*]Fixed incorrect Exopod pickup name
[*]Fixed HUD sounds sometimes being cut off by gameplay sounds
[*]Beehive fragments more reliably targets multiple enemies
[*]Removed "use" key from controls list
[/list]
Stay safe out there, and remember to help yourself to a little gold.
